verdict.rationale: Smithery is an MCP server registry, so published quality signals are a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence documents usage counts, health or liveness checks, scores, or verification badges. The registry probe shows entries carrying only qualifiedName, displayName and description. The security scan of top servers was run by an independent community member, not published by Smithery.

support.subject: As a developer, I can compare servers using published quality signals — usage counts, health or liveness checks, scores, or verification badges
